Hi Marcus — answered inline: 

1) Expedited fulfillment: available for A100 and A100-Lite with a 21-day SLA from PO receipt for confirmed slots. Standard is 70–95 days depending on port. The "ShipCalendar" tab should be read as target weeks; we'll provide committed slot dates once PO + deposit are received.

2) A100-Lite differences: lower device memory (40% less), same driver family but different SKU microcode. We recommend a quick perf smoke test — most customers see ~8–12% throughput variance on large batch workloads; real-time latency at small seq lengths is usually unaffected.

3) Ports: LA and Hamburg assumed. For EU-only customers we can route via Rotterdam but add ~7–10 days.
